package nats

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestDecodeLearningActivityInteresting(t *testing.T) {
	occurredAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC).Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	payload := []byte(`{
  "schema_version":1,
  "event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type":"learning.activity.interesting",
  "correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "student_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "occurred_at":"` + occurredAt + `",
  "data":{
    "event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
    "student_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    "analytics_session_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
    "course_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
    "lesson_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
    "task_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
    "signal_type":"repeated_failure",
    "consecutive_failures":3,
    "same_error_count":3,
    "active_seconds":480,
    "idle_seconds":0,
    "progressing":false,
    "error_fingerprint":"assertion-x",
    "occurred_at":"` + occurredAt + `"
  }
}`)
	signal, err := DecodeLearningActivityInteresting(payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "repeated_failure", signal.SignalType)
	require.Equal(t, 3, signal.SameErrorCount)
}

func TestDecodeLearningActivityInterestingRejectsIdentityDrift(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := DecodeLearningActivityInteresting([]byte(`{"schema_version":1,"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","event_type":"learning.activity.interesting","correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","student_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","occurred_at":"2026-08-31T18:00:00Z","data":{"event_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"}}`))
	require.Error(t, err)
}
